stemMd: An arithmetic sequence begins 7, 12, 17, ... . What is its twelfth term?
explanationMd: The common difference is 5. The twelfth term follows eleven increments after the first, so it is 7+11 times 5=62.

distractorRationale.a: This gives only the total increase, omitting the initial seven.
distractorRationale.d: This makes twelve increments instead of eleven.
distractorRationale.b: This treats the first term as five rather than seven.
